origin: Constructed controls and scripted probability baselines; not an agent rollout or measured biology

observation_model.evidence_level: abstract probability model; not calibrated to biological measurements
observation_model.repeat_rule: Quality is fixed for a sample. New paid measurements have fresh error conditional on that quality; they are not marginally independent. Reopening a receipt gives the original result.
observation_model.sample_rule: A reaction is one immutable experiment; a source is one well and delivered lot; a thermometer shares one module-session quality across checks and calibrations.
observation_model.interpretation: run_gel and thermometer_check return categorical findings, not physical band sizes or exact temperatures. All findings can occur in either condition.

distribution_controls.baseline_scope: Scripted exact posterior for a binary reference condition; not an autonomous agent, optimal repair policy, or empirical assay validation

NEB product protocol overview; appropriate terminal overlaps and 50 C incubation.

assumptions: Seven prepared stocks each contain an exact data/sequences core plus a constructed 30 bp closing/adjacent overlap. Preparation is assumed, not performed by the OT-2.
Equal 0.03 pmol per piece at 1 uL each is set by constructed stock concentrations. 20 uL reaction, 1X master mix, 50 C and 60 min are benchmark gates.
Seven-piece acceptance criteria extrapolate beyond the cited NEB 4-6 piece formulation; no seven-piece efficiency or yield is claimed.
The sequence called backbone is the original trailing genomic remainder, not a cloning vector. Circularity is a constructed target topology.
No kinetic/yield or functional biological model. Heating must follow final additions/mixing.
